stem.en:
Gulnora finished her science project two days ______ spent the extra time checking her measurements.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Two complete sentences meet here. A semicolon can join them; a comma alone makes a comma splice, and no mark makes a run-on.
why.uz: Bu yerda ikki toʻliq gap tutashadi. Ularni nuqtali vergul bogʻlay oladi; yolgʻiz vergul xato (comma splice), belgisiz esa gaplar qoʻshilib ketadi.
why.ru: Здесь встречаются два полных предложения. Их может соединить точка с запятой; одна запятая — ошибка (comma splice), без знака — слитное предложение.

stem.en:
Aziz's recipe for plov calls for a few basic ______ rice, carrots, onions, meat, and oil.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: A colon introduces a list after a complete sentence. A semicolon or period would leave the list as a fragment.
why.uz: Toʻliq gapdan keyin roʻyxatni ikki nuqta kiritadi. Nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta qoʻyilsa, roʻyxat chala gap boʻlib qoladi.
why.ru: Двоеточие вводит перечень после законченного предложения. С точкой с запятой или точкой перечень станет неполным предложением.

stem.en:
The library will close early on Friday for a staff training ______ reopen at the usual time on Saturday morning.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: 'It will reopen...' is a new complete sentence, so it needs a period before it. A comma here would create a comma splice.
why.uz: «It will reopen...» yangi toʻliq gap, shuning uchun undan oldin nuqta kerak. Vergul qoʻyilsa, comma splice xatosi boʻladi.
why.ru: «It will reopen...» — новое полное предложение, перед ним нужна точка. Запятая здесь даст ошибку comma splice.

stem.en:
My cousin ______ lives in Namangan, sends us dried apricots every autumn.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: 'who lives in Namangan' is extra information closed by a comma after 'Namangan', so it must also open with a comma.
why.uz: «who lives in Namangan» qoʻshimcha maʼlumot boʻlib, «Namangan» dan keyin vergul bilan yopilgan, shuning uchun u vergul bilan ochilishi ham kerak.
why.ru: «who lives in Namangan» — дополнительная информация, закрытая запятой после «Namangan», поэтому открываться она тоже должна запятой.

stem.en:
The bus was late this ______ we still arrived before the concert began.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: A comma goes before 'but' when it joins two sentences; no comma is needed after 'but'.
why.uz: «but» ikki gapni bogʻlaganda vergul undan oldin qoʻyiladi; «but» dan keyin vergul kerak emas.
why.ru: Когда «but» соединяет два предложения, запятая ставится перед ним; после «but» запятая не нужна.

stem.en:
The box of old photographs that Grandma keeps under her bed ______ pictures from her wedding day.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The subject is 'box' (singular), not 'photographs', so the verb must be singular: 'contains'.
why.uz: Ega «photographs» emas, «box» (birlik), shuning uchun feʼl ham birlikda boʻladi: «contains».
why.ru: Подлежащее — «box» (ед. ч.), а не «photographs», поэтому глагол в единственном числе: «contains».

stem.en:
Last summer, Shahzoda ______ to swim at the lake near her grandparents' village.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: 'Last summer' is a finished time in the past, so the simple past 'learned' is needed.
why.uz: «Last summer» oʻtmishda tugagan vaqt, shuning uchun oddiy oʻtgan zamon kerak: «learned».
why.ru: «Last summer» — завершённое время в прошлом, поэтому нужен простой прошедший: «learned».

stem.en:
The museum opened ______ new science wing to visitors last weekend.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The wing belongs to the museum (singular), so the possessive 'its' is needed. 'It's' means 'it is', and 'its'' is never correct.
why.uz: Qanot muzeyga tegishli (birlik), shuning uchun egalik shakli «its» kerak. «It's» = «it is», «its'» esa hech qachon toʻgʻri emas.
why.ru: Крыло принадлежит музею (ед. ч.), нужна притяжательная форма «its». «It's» = «it is», а «its'» не бывает правильным.

Before the final match, all eleven ______ uniforms were washed and neatly folded.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The uniforms belong to eleven players, a plural noun, so the possessive is 'players'' with the apostrophe after the s.
why.uz: Formalar oʻn bir oʻyinchiga tegishli (koʻplik), shuning uchun egalik shakli «players'», apostrof s dan keyin.
why.ru: Форма принадлежит одиннадцати игрокам (мн. ч.), поэтому притяжательная форма «players'» с апострофом после s.

stem.en:
Every evening after dinner, my grandfather ______ a short walk around the neighborhood.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The sentence needs a main verb that agrees with 'my grandfather' (singular): 'takes'. 'Taking' and 'to take' cannot be the main verb.
why.uz: Gapga «my grandfather» (birlik) bilan moslashgan asosiy feʼl kerak: «takes». «Taking» va «to take» asosiy feʼl boʻla olmaydi.
why.ru: Нужен основной глагол, согласованный с «my grandfather» (ед. ч.): «takes». «Taking» и «to take» не могут быть сказуемым.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: 'However' starts a new independent clause, so a semicolon goes before it and a comma after it.
why.uz: «However» yangi mustaqil gapni boshlaydi, shuning uchun undan oldin nuqtali vergul, keyin esa vergul qoʻyiladi.
why.ru: «However» начинает новое независимое предложение: перед ним точка с запятой, после него запятая.

stem.en:
The farmers' market had one clear advantage over the supermarket ______ every vegetable on its tables had been picked that morning.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The second part explains the 'one clear advantage', and a colon introduces such an explanation. A comma or nothing would join two sentences wrongly.
why.uz: Ikkinchi qism «one clear advantage» ni tushuntiradi, bunday izohni ikki nuqta kiritadi. Vergul yoki belgisizlik ikki gapni notoʻgʻri qoʻshadi.
why.ru: Вторая часть объясняет «one clear advantage», а такое пояснение вводит двоеточие. Запятая или отсутствие знака неверно соединят два предложения.

stem.en:
The bridge's designer, a young engineer from Fergana who had never worked on a project of this ______ completed the plans in just six months.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The description of the designer opens with a comma after 'designer', so it must close with a comma too. A dash cannot close a comma pair.
why.uz: Muhandis haqidagi izoh «designer» dan keyin vergul bilan ochilgan, shuning uchun vergul bilan yopilishi kerak. Tire juft vergulni yopa olmaydi.
why.ru: Пояснение о конструкторе открыто запятой после «designer», значит, и закрыться должно запятой. Тире не может закрыть пару запятых.

Our reading club has met in three places this year: the school library, where we started in ______ a café on Bog Street, which gave us a quiet back room; and a classmate's garden, our favorite spot in spring.

why.en: The list items already contain commas, so semicolons separate them, as after 'back room'. The first item must end the same way.
why.uz: Roʻyxat bandlarining ichida vergul bor, shuning uchun ular «back room» dan keyingi kabi nuqtali vergul bilan ajratiladi. Birinchi band ham shunday tugaydi.
why.ru: Внутри пунктов списка есть запятые, поэтому пункты разделяются точкой с запятой, как после «back room». Первый пункт заканчивается так же.

stem.en:

why.uz: «Neither... nor» bilan feʼl yaqinroq egaga moslashadi: «players» (koʻplik), shuning uchun «have» toʻgʻri.
why.ru: При «neither... nor» глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим «players» (мн. ч.), поэтому верно «have».

By the time the rain stopped, the children ______ the entire puzzle on the living room floor.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The puzzle was done before another past event (the rain stopped), so the past perfect 'had finished' is needed.
why.uz: Jumboq oʻtmishdagi boshqa voqeadan (yomgʻir tinishidan) oldin tugagan, shuning uchun Past Perfect kerak: «had finished».
why.ru: Пазл был собран до другого события в прошлом (дождь кончился), поэтому нужен Past Perfect: «had finished».

stem.en:
Walking into the kitchen after a long day at school, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: Dilshod smelled the soup his mother had made.
the smell of soup greeted Dilshod at the door.
the soup his mother had made smelled wonderful to Dilshod.
there was a smell of soup that Dilshod noticed.

why.en: The opening phrase describes someone walking, so the word right after the comma must be that person: Dilshod, not the smell or the soup.
why.uz: Boshlangʻich ibora yurayotgan odamni tasvirlaydi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin aynan u kelishi kerak: hid yoki shoʻrva emas, Dilshod.
why.ru: Начальный оборот описывает того, кто идёт, поэтому сразу после запятой должен стоять он сам: Дилшод, а не запах или суп.

stem.en:
The tortoise at the city zoo, ______ shell is marked with faint yellow lines, is a favorite with young visitors.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The shell belongs to the tortoise, so the possessive relative pronoun 'whose' is needed. 'Who's' means 'who is'.
why.uz: Kosa toshbaqaga tegishli, shuning uchun egalikni bildiruvchi «whose» kerak. «Who's» = «who is».
why.ru: Панцирь принадлежит черепахе, поэтому нужно притяжательное «whose». «Who's» = «who is».
